parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: `You are analyzing a single lecture transcript file.

## Your Task
Read the file \`/transcripts/${$json.filename}\` and create a comprehensive markdown summary.

## Create Output Directory
First, ensure /transcripts/summaries/ directory exists (mkdir -p /transcripts/summaries).

## Extract From This File:

### Questions & Answers
- Every question asked (by instructor or participants)
- The answer or response given
- Follow-up questions and clarifications
- Questions left unanswered or deferred

### Content Coverage
- Main topics discussed (in order of appearance)
- Key concepts introduced with definitions
- Technical terms and jargon explained
- Examples and case studies mentioned

### Actionable Information
- Tools, software, or platforms mentioned (with context)
- Websites, resources, or references cited
- Methodologies or frameworks discussed
- Best practices or recommendations given

### Notable Moments
- Particularly insightful explanations
- Controversial or debated points
- Surprising facts or statistics
- Personal anecdotes or real-world experiences shared

### Metadata
- Apparent topic/title of the session
- Estimated duration (from timestamps)
- Number of speakers (if distinguishable)
- Overall tone (lecture, Q&A, workshop, discussion)

## Output Format
Write to \`${$json.outputPath}\`:

# [Session Title/Topic]

**Source**: ${$json.filename}
**Duration**: ~XX minutes
**Format**: [Lecture/Q&A/Workshop/etc.]

## Questions Asked & Answered

### Q1: [Question text]
**Answer**: [Summary of answer]
**Timestamp**: [if available]

[...continue for all questions...]

## Key Topics Covered

### [Topic 1]
[2-3 sentence summary]
- Key point 1
- Key point 2

[...continue for all topics...]

## Tools & Resources Mentioned
- **[Tool Name]**: [Context of how it was mentioned]
- **[Website]**: [Why it was referenced]

## Notable Quotes & Insights
> "[Direct quote if notable]"
- [Insight or observation]

## Summary
[3-5 sentence overview of the entire session]

## Instructions
- Be thorough - capture EVERYTHING of value
- Preserve specificity - don't generalize away details
- Note uncertainty - if something is unclear, say so
- After writing the file, output only: "COMPLETE: ${$json.filename}"

Read /transcripts/${$json.filename} and begin.`, maxTurns: 15, workingDir: '/transcripts' }) }}
